This claim is IMPLEMENTED_SOURCE + EXACT_GITHUB_READBACK only.

acceptanceReview.sourceEvidence: HeartbeatPersistedEnvelopeProjection.project rejects missing update identity, oversized payload, byte-count mismatch, malformed/noncanonical SHA metadata, and SHA mismatch before HeartbeatEnvelopeParser.parse is invoked.

acceptanceReview.criterion: Storage rejection preserves contact without preserving stale transition motion.

codeFirstFinding.finding: The first 1400 implementation returned the exact lastGood frame object on storage rejection. That would have preserved a prior node.transitionMotion=true bit and reintroduced the stale-motion contradiction repaired by earlier scene-graph work.
